During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an Imperial [[Nal Yeshu listening post|listening post]] on [[Nal Yeshu]] was '''attacked''' by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hired by the Republic. The pirates completely destroyed the outpost, leaving behind only a smoking ruin.<ref name="Dead" />
